answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 1188 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is it permissable to have ones bed facing the qiblah? Is it proven in any hadith that our feet should not face the qiblah? Question: Is it permissable to have ones bed facing the qiblah? Is it proven in any hadith that our feet should not face the qiblah? Answer ID: 1188 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 808/757=B) The Hadith prohibits us from facing Qibla direction at the time of excretions (discharging urine and stool): اذا أتیتم الغائط فلا تستقبلوا القبلۃ ولا تستدبروھا و لکن شرقوا او غربوا This prohibition is based on desecration, and the same desecration is found in stretching the leg towards Qibla as well; therefore the scholars of Fiqh have derived this ruling that stretching leg towards Qibla is disliked: ویکرہ مد رجلیہ فی نوم او غیرہ الیھا عمداً لانہ اساءۃ ادب (شامی: 2/427) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
